semanticChecks: Brain infarction occlusion versus hemorrhage rupture and site/extent-dependent remaining ability retained. Angina temporary reduced myocardial flow versus infarction injury/necrosis retained; pain alone cannot differentiate. Hypertension/diabetes/coronary changes and medical-professional confirmation of diagnosis/treatment retained.

Heart failure is diminished cardiac function/insufficient output with multiple possible observation clues, not one-sign diagnosis. Cerebrovascular signs are not disease-exclusive. Sudden paralysis/speech change/acute dyspnea/severe chest pain require emergency assistance/report without waiting for causal certainty.

No forced posture or universal forward-lean instruction. Tolerable posture follows medical-professional instructions and individual plan, without assuming recovery. Salt/fluid/activity follow assessed treatment/care plan; no label-based restriction or forced exercise. Long-term management distinct from acute initial response; report time/personwords/baseline/actions to medical professionals.

Pneumonia inflammation and possible subtle presentation in older adults retained. Dysphagia process distinct from aspiration airway entry; saliva bacteria and silent aspiration retained. Mouth hygiene and appropriate posture/food form reduce risk without complete prevention guarantee. Nurse and speech/hearing therapist recipients explicit. Abnormal breathing/choking/voice/facial change stops feeding assistance and triggers facility help/report, not continued feeding to test. No unilateral changes, testing, drugs or emergency technique instructions.

Type1 immune-related pancreatic cell injury/insulin deficiency may begin any age; age cannot determine type. Type2 reduced insulin effect and insufficient secretion with multiple factors, no overeating blame. Possible high-glucose symptoms and few-symptom cases retained. Medical-confirmed diagnosis, planned glucose measurement/treatment and role limits retained; no independent food/activity/drug choices.

Retinal/renal/peripheral nerve complications distinct; medical coordination retained. Sensory loss may reduce pain with wounds; persistent high glucose may delay healing. Personwords and observed skin recorded separately; location/appearance/sensation/time reported per plan. No omitted record or unilateral topical treatment hiding course. Food satisfaction/preferences and responsible-staff consultation retained.

Visual acuity versus field, individual seeing, central scotoma and narrow field distinguished. Enlargement does not restore field. Spatial neglect is brain-related attention difficulty, distinct from field loss and possibly coexisting. Ask person, assessment/preferences, object location/light/text/explanation retained; no unauthorized rearrangement removing cues. No picture-based field/lesion diagnosis.

Pacemaker instructions and avoiding impact retained without all-activity ban/settings change. Hemodialysis external circulation removes some unwanted substances/excess water then returns blood; access route protected. Arm load/bath day/method/salt/fluid individualized with treatment team, no blanket dialysis-day bath ban or equal fluid limits. Bleeding/swelling promptly reported.

Oxygen cylinder/concentrator distinct from ventilation-support device. Oxygen supports combustion; fire/severe burn risk retained, no flow/settings changes. Device-specific fire/infection/power/supply contingency and variable backup power/supply retained. Bowel versus urinary stoma and not every bladder disorder has stoma retained. Plan/training, peristomal changes/leaks reporting, inexperienced-worker limits retained; prose alone cannot authorize procedures.

Intellectual disability developmental intellectual/adaptive difficulties distinct from mental illness; same label different needs. Adult dignity/history/current stage/preferences/choice and abilities retained. Schizophrenia/mood disorders distinct, severe episodes may impair judgment/behavior but diagnosis never universal inability/danger label. Depression/mania descriptions and baseline/time/persondifficulty retained without one-conversation diagnosis.

Hallucination absent corresponding external stimulus versus delusion strong certainty despite reality discrepancy, and auditory hallucination subtype distinctly translated. Expert assessment required; validating fear/distress distinct from confirming content as fact. Calm listening/help, no arguing down or diagnosis-based refusal to listen; acute safety threat facility emergency response; no diagnostic/drug adjustment instructions.

All7questions preserve four distinct specific rationales/options with exact correct indices, certainty and negation. All7readings explicitly empty, none omitted or invented. All7artcaptions retain scene context and diagnostic/procedural limits.
